name: weatheo-climate-data
title: Weatheo climate data: city-level ERA5 temperature tables
description: City-level temperature tables behind the Weatheo climate reports (means, anomalies against the 2011-2025 baseline, hot days, tropical nights, frost days, extremes), derived from ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo. No OpenWeather-derived data.

sources.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels (Copernicus Climate Change Service)

resources.name: june-2026-heatwave
resources.title: June 2026 heatwave in Europe (15 June to 5 July 2026)

fields.name: city
fields.description: City name as shown on weatheo.com.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country code, upper case.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: City-centre latitude used to query the ERA5 grid.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: City-centre longitude used to query the ERA5 grid.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Number of days in the period covered for this city.

fields.name: era5_mean_temp_c
fields.description: Mean of the daily mean 2 m air temperature over the period, rounded to 0.1.

fields.name: era5_2011_2025_mean_temp_c
fields.description: Baseline: for each calendar day of the period, the mean of that day's daily mean temperature over the years 2011-2025, then averaged over the period. The 2011-2025 window is a 15-year recent baseline, warmer than a 1961-1990 reference.

fields.name: era5_anomaly_c
fields.description: era5_mean_temp_c minus era5_2011_2025_mean_temp_c (positive = warmer than the 2011-2025 baseline).

fields.name: era5_days_max_30c_plus
fields.description: Days whose daily maximum temperature is >= 30 °C.

fields.name: era5_days_max_35c_plus
fields.description: Days whose daily maximum temperature is >= 35 °C.

fields.name: era5_nights_min_20c_plus
fields.description: Tropical nights: days whose daily minimum temperature is >= 20 °C.

fields.name: era5_frost_days
fields.description: Frost days: days whose daily minimum temperature is below 0 °C.

fields.name: era5_highest_c
fields.description: Highest daily maximum temperature in the period.

fields.name: era5_highest_date
fields.description: Date of that highest daily maximum.

fields.name: era5_lowest_c
fields.description: Lowest daily minimum temperature in the period.

fields.name: era5_lowest_date
fields.description: Date of that lowest daily minimum.

fields.name: forecast_page
fields.description: Absolute link to the city's forecast page on weatheo.com.
